title: Collapsable facets
body:
In some UI with a lot of facets, it seems people would want to be able to collapse/expand them on click.

We should provide this functionnality built-in, it would allow us to avoid rendering while the widget is collapsed (++ perf).

comments.body:
Was done, to be released as

``` js
collapsible: { // it it collapsible
  collapsed: true // is it collapsed at first
}
```

For all widgets having a header option
